description: This file defines a React component named TenantBootstrapGate that wraps protected routes in the application, ensuring that tenant bootstrap logic runs before rendering nested routes. It imports React, Outlet from react-router-dom, and a TenantBootstrap component, and renders these within a React fragment.

methods.name: TenantBootstrapGate()
methods.description: React functional component that wraps protected routes, rendering TenantBootstrap and Outlet to manage tenant-specific initialization before displaying nested content.
